note: Plugin-owned recipes for Govel Admin Jobs. Create after installing/activating govel-syncio. Core does not seed Syncio jobs. Syncio consumes govel-shopify shops by govel_shop_id. Catalog apply: POST /api/inventory/set, PATCH/POST /api/products. Order forward: POST /api/orders on source (orders.write); tracking back via POST /api/orders/{id}/fulfillments on dest (orders.fulfillment_write).

config.note: Persists govel_syncio_product_mapping rows (also mirrored in plugin JSON store).
Plans deltas from ListProducts inventory_quantity; apply calls POST /api/inventory/set (catalog.inventory_write).
Pushes toggled attributes via PATCH /api/products/{id}; create-missing via POST /api/products when connection.create_missing_products (catalog.product_write).
For paid/open dest orders with product mappings: CreateOrder on source (orders.write). Persists govel_syncio_order_mapping.
Reads source fulfillments for mapped orders; create/update dest fulfillment tracking (orders.fulfillment_write).
